TITLE: Legal corpus
subtitle: The EU and Lithuanian legal acts, and the standards, compliance is assessed against.

CONFIRM.refreshAllText: The sources (EUR-Lex, e-TAR, the Bank of Lithuania) are checked for new versions; changed acts are ingested again.
CONFIRM.reembedText: Every act's chunks are embedded again — only needed after the embedding model changed. This uses the AI model and costs money.

ADD.title: New legal act
ADD.shortTitleHintStandard: The designation, e.g. ISO/IEC 27001:2022 — references and the chat find the standard by it
ADD.domainsHint: Lowercase latin letters, e.g. aml, ict_security — type and press Enter
ADD.standardHint: A standard applies to the companies that adopted it — record that on the company's Standards tab. The system reads the copy's structure — numbered clauses and annexes by rules, a framework's own identifiers (AC-2, GV.OC-01) with the AI model, pages when it finds neither — indexes it for search and citation checks, and extracts the requirements a report assesses.
ADD.fileHint: A PDF, DOCX, HTML or TXT file
ADD.fileHintStandard: A PDF with selectable text works best. A scanned copy has to be turned into text (OCR) first; a DOCX loses its automatic clause numbers, so its headings are read by the AI model
ADD.lbOnly: The address must be on www.lb.lt
ADD.queued: Legal act added; its ingestion is queued.
ADD.uploadFailed: The legal act was added, but its file could not be uploaded: {reason} Upload it again on the act's page.

SEARCH.hint: Hybrid search over the acts' text: semantic and keyword.
SEARCH.cost: The search uses the embedding model (a small cost).

CITATIONS.intro: Check whether the legal articles an internal document cites exist and whether their headings match the stated topic.
CITATIONS.rowIncomplete: Give the act and the article
CITATIONS.costNote: When a topic is given, the AI model judges the match — it counts against your daily budget.

emptyText: Add legal acts — the compliance analysis depends on them.
emptyFiltered: No legal acts match the filters
loadError: The legal acts could not be loaded
